title: In a cloud session, wait-pid and verdict run by bare name, as the printed remedies say
why: The stall watcher (hooks/stall_watch.py) prints `wait-pid <pid>` as its remedy, but in a cloud container ~/.claude/bin is not on PATH, so the bare command fails with command not found and the wait ends at once while the job runs on. A builder also could not find `verdict` (lane notes-fix-large-2, 07:15 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: in a cloud session, `command -v wait-pid` and `command -v verdict` succeed, or every remedy that names them prints the path install.sh writes; a test pins whichever is chosen. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug and title by triage. Doing 09:57 CST Nov 8 in lane cloud-install (session_013NEJL2k68U41yt5xBhfp93), which takes cloud-install-code-check-config and cloud-bin-on-path together (coordinator, 09:55 CST). Sighting (lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm, 11:23 CST Nov 8): bare `wait-pid` and `verdict` gave rc 127 in a cloud lane, and the run swallowed the error, so it read as an instant return.
